title: Adams v. Lindsell — dispatch acceptance
summary: The note traces the common-law mailbox rule to the posted acceptance of a wool offer.
notes: It explains the offeree’s dependable basis for action and contrasts dispatch of acceptance with receipt of revocation. The agency fiction about the post office is criticized; the rule’s operation and its justification are distinct matters.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 262–263. Open assigned page 262.
